title: Gideon and the Extraction
author: E. M. Pemberton
blurb: Coral Zhou, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
